meta.price_basis: Canonical EUR net reference price history. CURRENT baseline is May 2026; historical anchors are kept as time-series entries and never overwrite newer baselines. Future July 2026 EUR prices derived from confirmed Microsoft USD/percentage changes are marked approximate.
meta.teams_caveat: EEA/EWR and global Teams packaging changes require separate with-Teams and no-Teams SKUs. Do not mix both variants in one price_history series.
meta.promo_policy: Promo prices are limited-time offers and must not enter price_history or tracker time series.

canonical_schema.promo_policy: Promo prices are stored only in sku.promo and never in price_history.
notes: prices_eur_net are net reference prices; annual_annual_permonth is the canonical monthly unit price for annual commitment paid yearly.
Teams and no-Teams variants are separate SKUs and must not be merged in one price series.
Future EUR rows derived from Microsoft-confirmed USD percentage increases are marked is_approx=true unless an exact EUR list price was available.
Reseller prices are tagged via verification_status/source_url and do not override newer Microsoft/current baseline rows.

nce_billing_fields.monthly_monthly: Monthly term, monthly payment; NCE flexible reference approximately +20%.
nce_billing_fields.annual_monthly: Annual term, monthly payment; same unit price unless direct surcharge is verified.
nce_billing_fields.annual_annual_permonth: Canonical monthly unit price for annual term paid yearly.
nce_billing_fields.triennial_permonth: Three-year planning anchor; approximately -5% if not directly verified.
